name: icon-coin
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single production-ready transparent PNG coin icon for Lulu, a European travel journal iPhone app. One large warm golden coin, slightly tilted for subtle visible thickness, with a simple embossed four-point compass star on its face. Hand-painted watercolor/gouache texture, softly uneven but crisp deep teal outline (#105859), warm ochre and honey gold, small cream highlights. Calm sophisticated travel stationery aesthetic, clear silhouette readable at 32 points. Centered square composition, coin occupies 85% of canvas. Actual transparent background with clean alpha, no paper rectangle, no shadow outside the coin, no surrounding marks or sparkles. No text, numbers, currency symbols, letters, watermark, or mockup. This is a standalone app icon asset, not an app screen.
processing: Original generated pixels and alpha retained. UIKit aspect-fit displays at 56 points for balance and 28 points for packages.
inspection: Inspected golden watercolor coin with teal compass motif, clean transparent surround and no text. No app runtime acceptance performed.
status: Superseded by front-facing icon-coin in individual-icons-2026-11-10.json; historical source only.
